scenes.text: Gemini can now *publish an app* to your *website* in one click

scenes.title: What *changed*
lines: Oct 19: build a calculator, quiz or dashboard in the Gemini app, hit Export, pick Google Sites.
It creates a private draft site you can publish. Personal Google accounts included.

scenes.title: The *money* use
lines: A quote calculator on your site turns visitors into leads.
Prompt: 'Build a lawn-care quote calculator: yard size, frequency, extras; show a price and a Book Now button.'

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: It's a Google Site, so it won't drop into WordPress or Shopify. Link to it instead.
Expect to fix the math by hand. Source: Google Workspace Updates, Oct 19; Chrome Unboxed, Oct 20, 2026.

scenes.title: The *cost*
lines: Free with a Google account that has Gemini. Google Sites is free.
Paid Gemini plans give more generations a day; the free tier is enough to ship one calculator.

scenes.text: What would you build: *calculator*, *quiz* or *dashboard*? Comment below.
